headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 elements. H1 must be highly impactful.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, input fields, and labels.

monospace.usage: Use strictly for numbers, currency (e.g., estimates, prices), stats, or code-like technical elements.

primary.name: Moss/Olive Green
primary.usage: Use sparingly for primary CTAs (buttons) and key visual accents. Represents calm, growth, trust.

background_light.name: Warm Off-White
background_light.usage: Base background for the light theme.

background_dark.name: Deep Architectural Slate
background_dark.usage: Base background for the dark theme.

surfaces.rules: Avoid pure black/white. No full-screen bright gradients. Muted transparent glows only. NEVER use a completely transparent background for floating elements.

layouts_and_grids.hero_section: Dual-audience segment control ('Je suis un particulier' / 'Je suis un pro') positioned above the H1. The H1, subtitle, and CTA change dynamically based on intent. Must include a high-converting lead capture form visible ABOVE the fold (Input for project description + Email + Primary CTA).
layouts_and_grids.trust_proofs: A dedicated horizontal banner right below the hero displaying patent FR261104, certifications, and '10 000+ pros' trust badge. Use muted opacity (opacity-60) for logos to integrate cleanly.
layouts_and_grids.key_features: Bento grid protocol for features (AI Estimation, Supplier Pricing, 3D Plan, PDF Quote, CRM). High density, gap-6 or gap-8. Mix spans. Use glassmorphic cards with muted glows on hover.
layouts_and_grids.categories_grid: Grid layout for work categories (e.g., plumbing, electricity) linking to '/estimation?type='. Use hover lifts (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadows.
layouts_and_grids.mobile_priority: Mobile-first approach is CRITICAL. The lead capture CTA must become a sticky element at the bottom of the screen on mobile if scrolled past. Forms must have large tap targets (min 44px). The dual journey segment must stack cleanly.

accessibility_and_i18n.i18n: Use `useI18n` / `t()` hook for all text to support FR/EN/ES/PT/IT/DE/AR.
accessibility_and_i18n.rtl: Ensure layout flips correctly for AR (Arabic) using standard Tailwind `rtl:` variants or logical properties (e.g., `ms-`, `me-`, `ps-`).
accessibility_and_i18n.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='hero-pro-segment-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are writing .js frontend files, not .tsx. Do not use TypeScript syntax.
Preserve all existing routes and functionality: Hero input must call `/smart-project`, category grid must link to `/estimation?type=`.

Implement the Dual Journey via a prominent Segmented Control (Toggle) in the Hero. 'Je suis un particulier' (default) / 'Je suis un pro'. This toggle must instantly swap the H1, subtitle, and form destination.
Lead capture form must be ABOVE the fold. Simple: Project description input + Email input + CTA button in primary Moss/Olive Green.
Implement Mobile Sticky CTA: On mobile screens, once the user scrolls past the hero form, a sticky CTA 'Estimer mon projet' must appear fixed at the bottom.
Strictly follow the color palette: Warm Off-White (#F9F9F8) for light mode bg, Deep Architectural Slate (#1A1D20) for dark mode bg. Avoid #000000 or #ffffff completely.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for surfaces with content underneath. Always use the specified glassmorphism rules.
Translate all copy via i18n hooks. Default to French (FR) strings in the UI implementation mapped to translation keys.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all buttons, inputs, and toggles.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, on-distribution outputs. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Use framer-motion where applicable.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder text for images or logos; rely on the provided image URLs.
Use sonner for toasts, if needed.
